0022600089.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons in this game, with the Utah Jazz on the road against the Memphis Grizzlies. Utah is without Jusuf Nurkic (out, foot) and Kyle Filipowski (day-to-day, back, game-time decision), while Memphis is without Isaiah Stewart (out, ankle), and GG Jackson (ankle), Micah Peavy (ankle), and Jerami Grant (rest) are all day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams split their 2025-26 series 2-2, and Utah won the most recent meeting 147-101 in Salt Lake City on April 10, 2026; ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Jazz a 55% chance to win.
